_comment: Workflow configuration. No secrets live here - those come from .env. See README.md.

inventory._comment: The site blocks plain HTTP clients (403), so a real browser is required. headless=false is the tested-reliable setting; headless sometimes gets rate-limited. Raise wait_ms on a slow connection.
inventory.user_agent: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/140.0.0.0 Safari/537.36

selection._comment: Units are taken in the site's own order (highest discount first). A unit must clear every rule here to be eligible.

image._comment: The exact-unit photo is downloaded from the unit's own listing. Nothing else is ever substituted.

graphic._comment: Fallback composer, used only when production.mode is 'produce' and no finished graphic was supplied. Requires assets/brand/logo.png - see README.

production._comment: 'validate_only' = ChatGPT supplies the finished graphic and description; this system verifies and promotes them. 'produce' = this system builds them from the verified listing. See the note in README about which the spec intends.

description._comment: Applies when production.mode = 'produce'. 'template' needs no API key; 'openai' needs OPENAI_API_KEY.

publishing._comment: No platform is wired until one is chosen and credentials are supplied. 'none' means the workflow stops at ready/ and publishing is recorded manually.
